description: Multi-modal transport activity counts capturing vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian volumes on instrumented road corridors across the City of Melbourne. Features 5-minute sampling intervals and approximately hourly upstream publication updates. Invariants strictly require preserving modal breakdowns without cross-contamination, refusing zero-filling for absent/missing intervals, and disclaiming universal municipality-wide street coverage. NOTE: Upstream dataset is verified blocked / unavailable (returns HTTP 404 / NotFoundResource); maintained as candidate with review_required.

invariants.category_preservation_rule: Preserves vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian modal categories distinctly; counts must never be cross-aggregated, collapsed, or misattributed across modes.
invariants.five_minute_sampling_rule: Sampling window is fixed at 5-minute granularity (sampling_interval_minutes: 5) with precise interval boundaries [valid_from, valid_to).
invariants.hourly_update_rule: Tracks upstream approximately hourly publication cadence (cadence_seconds: 3600) via ETag/Last-Modified or upstream batch timestamps.
invariants.no_zero_filling_rule: Missing intervals or omitted category counts must remain null with status 'missing'; absent periods indicate unobserved intervals, NEVER zero activity (0).
invariants.no_citywide_coverage_claim_rule: Counts represent only instrumented sensor sites and road segments; connector explicitly flags is_citywide_coverage: false and location_role: 'sensor_site', and does not claim full street network coverage.

notes: Upstream verification on 2026-09-30 confirmed that the dataset 'transport-activity-counts' at https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/transport-activity-counts/records returns HTTP 404 / NotFoundResource ('The requested dataset transport-activity-counts does not exist.'). A comprehensive audit of all 238 datasets on data.melbourne.vic.gov.au and Victorian government catalog search confirmed no active multi-modal transport activity counts dataset exists. Upstream status is explicitly recorded as 'blocked / unavailable'. Access status remains 'candidate' with license_status 'review_required'. Offline fixture parsing is maintained for candidate implementation verification, but fixtures must never be used to claim live success or admission.

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: All OpenDataSoft records match total_count; duplicate (sensor_id, time, direction) fail; missing counts remain null and are not zero-filled; no universal citywide coverage claimed. Upstream dataset currently returns HTTP 404 / NotFoundResource and is blocked / unavailable.
